name: sw-mis-source
description: Reference manifest for Smartworld Customer Complaint MIS. The app itself needs no npm build step - frontend/static/vendor/*.js are pre-built UMD bundles already checked into this repo. This file only documents which versions they came from.
notes: To refresh these bundles: npm install react@18 react-dom@18 htm chart.js@4, then re-copy the files above.
